nary_nodes.label: Magnitude 7.4 earthquake in Chocó
evidence: The magnitude 7.4 quake struck at 07:34 (12:34 GMT) at a depth of 103km (64 miles) in Chocó province

nary_nodes.label: State of emergency declared
evidence: a state of emergency has been declared

nary_nodes.label: National disaster situation declared
evidence: Colombia's President Abelardo de la Espriella has declared a national disaster situation

nary_nodes.label: Twin quakes in Venezuela
evidence: twin quakes devastated the north of Venezuela

nary_nodes.label: 85 deaths in Cali
evidence: Cali ... was the worst affected with 85 dead

nary_nodes.label: At least five deaths in Manizales
evidence: At least five people also died in Manizales

nary_nodes.label: 1.5 million felt strong shaking
evidence: an estimated 1.5 million people felt shaking close to magnitude seven

nary_nodes.label: Cali 200km from epicentre
evidence: Cali, located about 200km from the epicentre

nary_nodes.label: No deaths in San José del Palmar
evidence: local mayor León Fabio Marín Moncada said that there had miraculously been no deaths or injuries

nary_nodes.label: Dan Cutler's experience
evidence: he told the BBC: "I've never experienced anything like it."

nary_nodes.label: Angélica Ávila's account
evidence: Speaking to BBC World Service, Angélica Ávila said she had been staying in a hotel in Manizales.

nary_nodes.label: Molina explains building resistance
evidence: He explained that due to previous earthquakes, the city has "very strict seismic-resistant building regulations" - so his building was able to resist the impact.

nary_nodes.label: Asocapitales reports injuries and fatalities
evidence: Colombia's Association of Capital Cities (Asocapitales) wrote in an update on Tuesday.

nary_nodes.label: USGS estimates shaking exposure
evidence: According to the US Geological Survey, an estimated 1.5 million people felt shaking close to magnitude seven.

nary_nodes.label: USGS on deep earthquake danger
evidence: It stated that deep earthquakes, like the one which hit on Monday, are usually less dangerous than earthquakes which break closer to the Earth's surface.

nary_nodes.label: Pope saddened by earthquake
evidence: A spokesman for Pope Leo XIV said the pontiff was "deeply saddened to learn the painful news of the earthquake".

nary_nodes.label: US ready to support
evidence: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the US was "closely monitoring" the earthquake, and stood "ready to support"

nary_nodes.label: EU using Copernicus satellite
evidence: EU chief Ursula von der Leyen said the EU's Copernicus satellite was being used in the rescue operation.

nary_nodes.label: Bukele offers solidarity and aid
evidence: The president of El Salvador, Nayib Bukele, sent a message of solidarity to the Colombian people and offered personnel and equipment for rescue efforts.
